objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled object that is created, edited, reviewed, released, and archived as part of the document management process.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the document in its lifecycle (e.g., Editing, Released, Out of Force)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date after which the document's validity expires

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the document becomes valid

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The classification of the document (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Work Instruction, Procedural Instruction)

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: A code assigned to the document

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document that is automatically released with the main document and triggers new versions when modified or archived.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the attachment in its lifecycle

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and having no effect on main document versioning.

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Whether the additional information is published or not

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal to amend an existing document without affecting its content or version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the change proposal (e.g., Pending, Implemented, Completed)

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: An automated request created when a document reaches 30 days before expiry to determine if the document should be extended, revised, or invalidated.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the validity extension request

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document that has no additional validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the override request

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document and restore it to active use.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the reactivation request

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual who interacts with the document management system in various roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The system role assigned to the user (e.g., Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, Translator)

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned to specific roles or distribution purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The identifier of the user group

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The purpose of the group (e.g., Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive)

evts.name: document_created
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system with initial properties.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen for the new document

evts.name: document_properties_maintained
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are set or updated in the system.

attributes.name: properties_updated
attributes.description: The document properties that were modified

evts.name: document_content_edited
evts.description: The content of a document is modified using an editing client.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: The format of the document being edited (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

evts.name: document_converted_to_pdf
evts.description: The edited document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: document_published
evts.description: A released document is made visible to readers on the web.

evts.name: review_started
evts.description: The document review workflow step is initiated to check content and formal aspects.

evts.name: document_reviewed
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document's content according to technical and formal aspects.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: The type of review conducted (e.g., Technical, Formal)

evts.name: document_signed
evts.description: A document is signed electronically by a workflow participant.

attributes.name: signer_role
attributes.description: The role of the person signing the document (e.g., Author, Reviewer, Releaser)

evts.name: document_released
evts.description: A document is formally approved and released for distribution to readers.

evts.name: document_archived
evts.description: A released or invalidated document is marked for archiving and its authorizations are revoked.

evts.name: document_revised
evts.description: Changes are made to a released document, creating a new version in editing status.

evts.name: change_proposal_created
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal to amend an existing document.

evts.name: change_proposal_implemented
evts.description: A proposed change is scheduled for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: change_proposal_completed
evts.description: The editing of an assigned change proposal is documented and marked as completed.

evts.name: validity_extended
evts.description: A document's validity is extended for a defined period following a validity extension process.

evts.name: document_invalidated
evts.description: A document is declared out of force and archived due to loss of validity.

evts.name: document_reactivated
evts.description: A previously invalidated document is re-validated and returned to active use.

evts.name: document_translated
evts.description: A released document's content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language the document is translated to

evts.name: translation_released
evts.description: A translated document version is formally approved and released for readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: distribution_list_maintained
evts.description: Users and user groups are assigned to the distribution list for a document.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: The type of distribution (e.g., Email, Acknowledgement)

evts.name: distribution_email_sent
evts.description: Users are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: acknowledgement_requested
evts.description: Users are requested to actively confirm their acknowledgement of a released document.

evts.name: acknowledgement_confirmed
evts.description: A user confirms receipt and understanding of a document.

o2o.description: A change proposal clearly belongs to and is displayed in a document
